verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              कथं धर्मे स्थातुमिच्छन्नरो वर्तेत भारत। विद्वन् जिज्ञासमानाय प्रब्रूहि भरतर्षभ॥१॥
verses.english: Bhishma said-Hear me, O king, I describe the symptoms that appeared on the body of Vritra when he was possessed by that fever.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं चेवानृतं चोभे लोकानावृत्य तिष्ठतः। दयोः किमाचरेद्राजन्पुरुषो धर्मनिश्चितः॥२॥
verses.english: The heroic Asura's mouth began to send out flames of fire. He became greatly pale. His body began to tremble all over. His breath became hard.

verses.sanskrit: किंस्वित्सत्यं किमनृतं किंस्विद्धर्म्यं सनातनम्। कस्मिन्काले वदेत्सत्यं कस्मिन्कालेऽनृतं वदेत्॥३॥
verses.english: His hairs stood erect. His breath was very hard. His memory, O Bharata, went out of his mouth in the shape of a dreadful, and inauspicious jackal. Burning and blazing meteors dropped on his right and left.

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              सत्यस्य वचनं साधु न सत्याद्विद्यते परम्। यत्तु लोकेषु दुर्ज्ञानं तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि भारत॥४॥
verses.english: Vultures, Kankas, and cranes yelled fierce cries, as they moved over Vritra's head.

verses.sanskrit: भवेत्सत्यं न वक्तव्यं वक्तव्यमनृतं भवेत्। यत्रानृतं भवेत्सत्यं सत्यं वाप्यनृतं भवेत्॥५॥
verses.english: Then, in that battle, Indra, worshipped of the gods, and armed with the thunderbolt, looked hard at the demon as the latter sat on his car.

verses.sanskrit: तादृशो बध्यते बालो यत्र सत्यमनिष्ठितम्। सत्यानृते विनिश्चित्य ततो भवति धर्मवित्॥६॥
verses.english: Possessed by that dreadful fever, the powerful Asura, O king, yawned and uttered inhuman cries.

verses.sanskrit: अप्यनार्यो कृतप्रज्ञः पुरुषोऽप्यतिदारुणः। सुमहत्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यं बलाकोऽन्धवधादिव॥७॥
verses.english: While the Asura was yawning, Indra discharged his thunderbolt at him. Endued with great enrgy and resembling the fire that destroys the creation at the end of the cycle, that thunderbolt overthrew in a moment Vritra of gigantic form.

verses.sanskrit: किमाश्चर्यं च यन्मूढो धर्मकामोऽप्यधर्मवित्। सुमहत्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यं गङ्गायामिव कौशिकः॥८॥
verses.english: The gods on all sides cried aloud when they saw Vritra killed, O foremost of Bharata's race.

verses.sanskrit: तादृशोऽयमनुप्रश्नो यत्र धर्मः सुदुर्लभः। दुष्करः प्रतिसंख्यातुं तत्केनात्र व्यवस्यति॥९॥
verses.english: Having killed Vritra, Mghavat, that enemy of the Danavas, of great entered heaven with that thunderbolt pervaded by Vishnu,

verses.sanskrit: प्रभवार्थाय भूतानां धर्मप्रवचनं कृतम्। यः स्यात्प्रभवसंयुक्तः स धर्म इति निश्चयः॥१०॥
verses.english: Just then, O you of Kuru's family, the sin of Brahmanicide, fierce and dreadful and striking all the worlds with fear, came out of the person of the killed Vritra.

verses.sanskrit: धारणाद्धर्ममित्याहुर्धर्मेण विधृताः प्रजाः। यः स्याद्धारणसंयुक्तः स धर्म इति निश्चयः॥११॥
verses.english: Of terrible teeth and dreadful countenance, hideous for ugliness, and dark and tawny, with hair dishevelled, and dreadful eyes, O Bharata, with a garland of skulls round her neck, and loO king like Incantation incarnate, O foremost of Bharatas, bathed in blood, and clad in rags and barks of trees, O you of righteous soul, she came out of Vritra's body. Of such dreadful form and countenance, O king, she sought the holder of the thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसार्थाय भूतानां धर्मप्रवचनं कृतम्। यः स्यादहिंसासंयुक्तः स धर्म इति निश्चयः॥१२॥
verses.english: A little while after, O you of Kuru's race, the killer of Vritra, for the behoof of the three worlds, was proceeding towards heaven.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतिधर्म इति ह्येके नेत्याहुरपरे जनाः। न च तत्प्रत्यसूयामो न हि सर्वं विधीयते॥१३॥
verses.english: Seeing Indra of great energy thus proceeding on his mission, she caught the king of the gods and from that moment stuck to him.

verses.sanskrit: येऽन्यायेन जिहीर्षन्तो धनमिच्छन्ति कस्यचित्। तेभ्यस्तु न तदाख्येयं स धर्म इति निश्चयः॥१४॥
verses.english: When the sin of Brahmanicide thus stuck to his body and filled him with terror, Indra entered the fibres of a lotus-stalk and lived there for many years.

verses.sanskrit: अकूजनेन चेन्मोक्षो नावकूजेत्कथंचन। अवश्यं कूजितव्ये वा शङ्करन्वाऽप्यकूजनात्॥१५॥
verses.english: But the sin of Brahmanicide followed him closely. Indeed, O son of Kuru, seized by her, Indra became shorn of all his energies.

verses.sanskrit: श्रेयस्तत्रानृतं वक्तुं सत्यादिति विचारितम्। यः पापैः सह सम्बन्धान्मुच्यते शपथादपि॥१६॥
न तेभ्योऽपि धनं देयं शक्ये सति कथंचन। पापेभ्यो हि धनं दत्तं दातारमपि पीडयेत्॥१७॥
verses.english: He tried much for driving her from him, but all those attempts proved useless,

verses.sanskrit: स्वशरीरोपरोधेन धनमादातुमिच्छतः। सत्यसम्प्रतिपत्त्यर्थं यद्ब्रूयुः साक्षिणः क्वचित्॥१८॥
verses.english: Seized by her, O foremost of Bharata's race, the king of the gods at last presented himself before the Grandfather and adored him by bending low his head.

verses.sanskrit: अनुक्त्वा तत्र तद्वाच्यं सर्वे तेऽनृतवादिनः। प्राणात्यये विवाहे च वक्तव्यमनृतं भवेत्॥१९॥
अर्थस्य रक्षणार्थाय परेषां धर्मकारणात्। परेषां सिद्धिमाकाङ्क्षन्नीचः स्याद्धर्मभिक्षुकः॥२०॥
verses.english: Knowing that Indra was possessed by the sin of Brahmanicide, Brahman began to think, 0 best of the Bharatas, (of the measures for freeing him).

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिश्रुत्य प्रदातव्यः स्वकार्यस्तु बलात्कृतः। यः कश्चिद्धर्मसमयात्प्रच्युतो धर्मसाधनः॥२१॥
verses.english: The Grandfather at last, O you of great arms, addressed Brahmanicide in sweet words as if from the desire of pacifying her, and said.-0 amiable one, let the king of the gods, who is a favourite of mine, be freed from you. Tell me, what shall I do for you? What wish of yours shall I satisfy?

verses.sanskrit: दण्डनैव स हन्तव्यस्तं पन्थानं समाश्रितः। च्युतः सदैव धर्मेभ्योऽमानवं धर्ममास्थितः॥२२॥
शठः स्वधर्ममुत्सृज्य तमिच्छेदुपजीवितुम्। सर्वोपायैर्निहन्तव्यः पापो निकृतिजीवनः॥२३॥
धनमित्येव पापानां सर्वेषामिह निश्चयः। अविषह्या ह्यसम्भोज्या निकृत्या पतनं गताः॥२४॥
verses.english: Brahmanicide said When the Creator of the three worlds, when the illustrious god worshipped of the universe, has been pleased with me, I consider my wishes as already fulfilled. Let my residence be now fixed.

verses.sanskrit: च्युता देवमनुष्येभ्यो यथा प्रेतास्तथैव त। निर्यज्ञास्तपसा हीना मा स्म तैः सह सङ्गमः॥२५॥
verses.english: Desirous of preserving the worlds, this rule has been laid down by you. It was you, O lord, who had introduced this important rule.

verses.sanskrit: धननाशाद्दुःखतरं जीविताद्विप्रयोजनम्। अयं ते रोचतां धर्म इति वाच्यः प्रयत्नतः॥२६॥
verses.english: As you have been pleased with me, O righteous Lord, O powerful Master of all the worlds, I shall surely leave Shakra! But grant me an abode to live in.

verses.sanskrit: न कश्चिदस्ति पापानां धर्म इत्येष निश्चयः। तथागतं च यो हन्यान्नासौ पापेन लिप्यते॥२७॥
verses.english: Bhishma said. The Grandfather replied to Brahmanicide, saying,-So be it! Indeed, the Grandfather found out means for removing Brahmanicide from the body of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: स्वकर्मणा हतं हन्ति हत एव स हन्यते। तेषु यः समयं कश्चित्कुर्वीत हतबुद्धिषु॥२८॥
verses.english: The Self-sprung thought of the great Agni. The latter immediately appeared before Brahman and said:-O illustrious and divine Lord, O defeatless one, I have appeared before you. You should say what I shall have to do.

verses.sanskrit: यथा काकाश्च गृध्राश्च तथैवोपधिजीविनः। अर्ध्वं देहविमोक्षान्ते भवन्त्येतासु योनिषु॥२९॥
verses.english: Bhishma said I shall divide this sin of Brahmanicide into several parts. For freeing Shakra from her, do you take a fourth portion of that sin.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् यथा वर्तते यो मनुष्यस्तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तितव्यं स धर्मः। मायाचारो मायया बाधितव्यः साध्वाचारः साधुना प्रत्युपेयः॥३०॥
verses.english: How shall I be saved from her, O Brahman? O powerful Lord, do you appoint the way. I wish to know the means fully, O worshipped of all the worlds.
